query: I just got back from walking my dog this morning, he was so excited to chase a squirrel up the oak tree at the end of the block that he pulled so hard his leash slipped out of my hand for a minute. Then I stopped by the neighborhood bakery on the way home and picked up a chocolate croissant that was still warm, it had the perfect amount of flaky layers and melted chocolate inside. I was thinking about planting some tomato seedlings on my balcony this weekend too, I already bought the pots and potting soil last week. Anyway, I need to modify my pending order #W4284542, please change item 8302289002 to 9534205511, and use gift_card_9368765 as the payment method for this adjustment.
